application.name: ResearchMate AI
application.description: An AI-powered research paper assistant for students and researchers. Generates publication-grade research paper proposals with verified citations, structured methodology, prospective hypothesis boundaries, and academic export tools.

features.name: Research Topic & Hypothesis Scoping
features.description: Natural language topic and hypothesis input with live word/character counters and one-click preset inspirations across academic disciplines.

features.name: Multi-Discipline Tailoring
features.description: Domain-tailored methodology, metrics, and literature benchmarks across Computer Science, Engineering, Medicine, Environment, Business, and custom fields.

features.name: Standard 9-Section Academic Blueprint
features.description: Synthesizes Title, Abstract & Keywords, Introduction, Problem Statement, Objectives, Literature Review, Methodology, Expected Results, Conclusion, and References.

features.name: Citation Integrity & Anti-Hallucination Audit
features.description: Strict prohibition against fabricated DOIs or hallucinated authors. Explicitly classifies citations into Verified Landmarks versus Proposed Benchmarks (requiring database verification), with one-click Google Scholar and CrossRef lookups.

features.name: Hypothesis & Prospective Bounds Isolation
features.description: Explicit demarcation distinguishing proposed theoretical predictions and hypothesized bounds from empirical measurements.

features.name: Live Academic Word Counter & Breakdown
features.description: Real-time document length tracking, reading time estimator (220 WPM), academic page estimator, and section-by-section distribution percentage breakdown against proposal benchmarks.

features.name: Multi-Style Typesetting & Format Switcher
features.description: Live formatting toggles between IEEE, APA 7th Edition, and Nature citation and heading styles with journal preprint title block styling.

features.name: Multi-Format Academic Exporters
features.description: One-click copy for individual sections and full document text, structured TXT file download, and direct BibTeX (.bib) reference export for LaTeX/Overleaf.

features.name: Local Research Archive & Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Client-side local storage persistence for proposals, aggregate statistics (total proposals, total words, verified landmarks, disciplines), search, and field filtering.

features.name: Sticky Document Outline Navigator
features.description: Smooth-scrolling table of contents allowing researchers to rapidly navigate between document sections on desktop and mobile viewports.

aiModelConfiguration.failoverStrategy: Race with 25-second timeout on primary candidate; automatic failover to fallback model upon 503 high demand or network stall.

thinkingConfig.description: Balances reasoning depth with low latency to prevent reverse proxy and iframe connection timeouts.

topic.label: Research Topic or Working Title
topic.placeholder: e.g., Evaluating quantum error mitigation techniques in NISQ-era superconducting quantum processors...
topic.validationMessage: Please provide a specific research topic or hypothesis (minimum 5 characters).

customField.label: Specify Domain / Sub-discipline
customField.condition: Visible and utilized when field is 'Other'

paperTitle.description: Formal scholarly title formulated for high-impact journal submission.

abstract.description: Concise, structured scholarly abstract (200-280 words) detailing background, problem, methodology, and theoretical impact.

keywords.description: 4 to 6 academic keywords or standard index terms.

introduction.description: Scholarly introduction setting theoretical background, significance, and scope.

problemStatement.description: Precise articulation of the research challenge, empirical bottlenecks, and current gaps in literature.

researchObjectives.description: 3 to 5 concrete, actionable, and numbered research goals.

literatureReview.description: Thematic critique of existing paradigms, theoretical tensions, and unresolved literature questions.

approach.description: Methodological paradigm (e.g., empirical, computational simulation, quasi-experimental).

dataCollectionOrSetup.description: Datasets, sample populations, experimental instruments, or simulation configurations.

analyticalProcedure.description: Step-by-step analytical algorithm, pipeline, or laboratory protocol.

evaluationMetrics.description: Quantitative benchmarks, statistical significance thresholds, and validation criteria.

ethicalAndValidityConsiderations.description: Internal and external validity safeguards, reproducibility considerations, and ethical compliance.

hypothesizedOutcomes.description: Anticipated findings framed strictly as theoretical predictions and prospective hypotheses.

theoreticalSignificance.description: Theoretical, computational, or clinical significance of findings if confirmed.

prospectiveDistinction.description: Mandatory academic distinction disclaimer declaring empirical validation is pending experimental execution.

conclusion.description: Scholarly synthesis of research vision, potential impact, limitations summary, and future research vectors.

doiOrUrl.description: Verified DOI or URL, or empty if unverified

verificationNote.description: Citation provenance explanation or lookup instructions for databases.

academicRigorNotice.description: Standard academic integrity statement regarding proposal status and citation verification.
